posts.author: EODM
posts.body:
Hello everyone. I go by the name of EODM.
I've dabbled in RPG Maker FES on the 3DS, so I've decided to try out MV which I've had for a few years now. I hope to get along with all of you.
30+ years old, and a fan of RPGs and Story Driven games (Grandia, Ace Attorney, Xenoblade for example). I've written stories in the past mainly for fun and have decided to try and put that to use for an RPG. Same goes with sprites and pixel art, as years ago, I solely did sprite edits, but have done sprites of characters in one game on the side for the past 4 years.
Currently in the idea phase of a project I've been making notes of for the past month, which I would love to try and make a reality. Again, I hope to get along with everyone here!

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
Welcome to the forum!
I think this is generally a pretty easy place for folks to get along.
Sounds like you already have some experience and having done pixel art in the past can only help.
Good luck on your projects!

posts.author: EODM
posts.body:
Thank you very much. I mainly have done sprite work of characters like Yu-Gi-Oh! and one of the Digimon for example. Which I wanted to try and use these to try and create an RPG instead.
Like this rough WIP of the Digimon, Lilithmon. I often do look for feedback on how to improve these things, and even am open to having people make adjustments or edits of them to move me in the right direction too.
